description: Дані про місце розміщення зупинок міського електричного та автомобільного транспорту is a dataset listed in data.gov.ua, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Хорольська міська рада. The set contains identification data of public transport stops, as well as information about their location (geographical coordinates, address), availability and other characteristics. Coverage: Хорольська міська рада. The portal shows the English title as "Data on the location of city electric and road transport stops" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Хорольська міська рада. Its keywords include автобус, зупинка, транспорт. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-08-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua.
